command:
set -eu
cat > /etc/systemd/system/srvdata-loop.service <<'ANTRIEB_UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=Attach loop-backed LVM PV for /srv/data
DefaultDependencies=no
After=systemd-remount-fs.service
Before=local-fs-pre.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/bin/sh -c '/usr/sbin/losetup -j /var/lib/lvm-data/data-pv.img | /usr/bin/grep -q . || /usr/sbin/losetup --find --show /var/lib/lvm-data/data-pv.img'
ExecStart=/usr/sbin/pvscan --cache
ExecStart=/usr/sbin/vgchange -ay vg_srvdata
RemainAfterExit=yes

[Install]
WantedBy=local-fs-pre.target
ANTRIEB_UNIT
if ! grep -q '^[^#].*[[:space:]]/srv/data[[:space:]]' /etc/fstab; then printf '%s\n' '/dev/vg_srvdata/lv_data /srv/data xfs defaults,x-systemd.requires=srvdata-loop.service 0 0' >> /etc/fstab; fi
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable srvdata-loop.service
systemctl start srvdata-loop.service
systemctl is-enabled srvdata-loop.service
systemctl is-active srvdata-loop.service
systemctl status srvdata-loop.service --no-pager -l | sed -n '1,14p'
printf '%s\n' '== persistent mount declaration =='
grep '[[:space:]]/srv/data[[:space:]]' /etc/fstab
